events.headline: Nordkamp halts shipments amid ownership dispute
events.text: Nordkamp Semiconductors has suspended wafer shipments from its main plant after a government intervention in its ownership. Delivery of its power control modules cannot be guaranteed.

events.headline: 25% tariff announced on imported aluminium housings
events.text: A 25% import tariff on aluminium housings takes effect next month, raising the landed cost of HSG-4.

events.headline: Port congestion at Rotterdam, nine-day delays
events.text: Congestion at Rotterdam is adding about nine days to inbound European shipments.

events.headline: Nordkamp parent credit rating downgraded
events.text: The parent of Nordkamp Semiconductors has been downgraded two notches by a rating agency.

events.headline: Unconfirmed: Tornelis facing insolvency
events.text: An unverified social-media post claims Tornelis Electronics is about to file for insolvency. No filing, statement or second source has been found.

events.headline: Storms forecast off the Gulf coast
events.text: A storm system may bring short delays to Gulf-coast freight next week.

events.headline: Castwell Forgings stops a production line
events.text: Castwell Forgings has stopped a line after a fire. Castwell is not a supplier to Halden.

events.headline: Meadowbrook Sensors reports a soft quarter
events.text: Meadowbrook Sensors, a qualified alternate for SNS-2 that Halden does not currently buy from, reported weaker quarterly results.
